headline.zh: 合并仍无协议；稀释担忧令 SPCX 盘中跌破 IPO 价后收涨 1.30%，FCC 批准百万卫星星座；TSLA 收跌 1.18%，美股感恩节休市
headline.en: Still no merger agreement; dilution fears push SPCX below its IPO price intraday before a 1.30% gain as the FCC approves its million-satellite constellation; TSLA closes down 1.18%, US markets shut for Thanksgiving

summary.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月 26 日（亚洲/新加坡），Tesla 与 SpaceX（SPCX）仍未宣布合并协议、换股比例或监管文件，两家公司也没有就合并发表新的官方声明。过去 24 小时没有新的合并进程报道，最新进程信息仍是 FT 11 月 24 日（未经公司确认）关于谈判委员会、顾问和年底目标的报道。市场层面的焦点转向「谁来承担溢价」：Gary Black 测算若 SpaceX 以 25% 溢价全股票收购特斯拉需增发约 52% 股份，周三 SPCX 早盘一度跌约 8% 至 IPO 价 135 美元以下，随后在 FCC 批准其 100 万颗卫星「Starmind」轨道数据中心星座后收复，收于 127.44 美元（+1.30%）。TSLA 受科技股抛售与欧盟把辅助驾驶会议推迟到 12 月 15 日拖累，收 380.14 美元（-1.18%）。另外 SpaceX 宣布向每个活跃 Trump Account 赠 1 股、马斯克个人配捐。马斯克在 X 上转发了赠股公告、感谢 FCC，没有谈合并。美股 11 月 26 日感恩节休市，27 日提前收盘。
summary.en: As of 26 November 2026 (Asia/Singapore), Tesla and SpaceX (SPCX) still have no announced merger agreement, exchange ratio or regulatory filing, and neither company has made a new official statement on the merger. There was no new reporting on the merger process in the past 24 hours; the latest remains the FT's 24 November report (not confirmed by the companies) on the negotiating committees, advisers and year-end target. Market focus shifted to who bears the premium: Gary Black estimated a 25%-premium all-stock SpaceX bid would require issuing about 52% more shares, and on Wednesday SPCX fell as much as about 8% early, below its $135 IPO price, before recovering after the FCC approved its 1-million-satellite 'Starmind' orbital data-center constellation to close at $127.44 (+1.30%). TSLA, hit by the tech sell-off and the EU moving its Assisted Driving meeting to 15 December, closed at $380.14 (-1.18%). SpaceX also pledged one share to every active Trump Account, with Musk personally matching. On X, Musk reposted the share-gift announcement and thanked the FCC but did not discuss the merger. US markets are closed on 26 November for Thanksgiving and close early on the 27th.

points.zh: 合并进程：过去 24 小时无新的确认或新报道。仍以 FT 11/24 报道为准（全股票、约 3.5 万亿美元、目标年底、「尚未接近达成」，未经公司确认）。
points.en: Merger process: nothing new confirmed or newly reported in the past 24 hours. The FT's 24 November report remains the reference (all-stock, about $3.5 trillion, year-end target, 'not close'; not confirmed by the companies).

points.zh: 稀释之争（投资人测算，非公司条款）：Gary Black 估 25% 溢价对应特斯拉约 481 美元/股、SpaceX 需增发约 52%，并认为套利沽空会让溢价「缩水到零」；Motley Fool 按汇丰 507 美元情景估算稀释可能超过 80%。
points.en: Dilution debate (investor estimates, not company terms): Gary Black puts a 25% premium at about $481 per Tesla share and roughly 52% new SpaceX shares, and expects arbitrage shorting to 'shrivel' the premium to zero; Motley Fool, using HSBC's $507 scenario, estimates dilution could exceed 80%.

points.zh: SpaceX 利好对冲：FCC 11/25 附条件批准最多 100 万颗「Starmind」轨道数据中心卫星（2033 年前开始部署）；SpaceX 还称将在亚利桑那 Colossus 3 超算基地投资 500 亿美元以上。
points.en: SpaceX offsets: on 25 November the FCC conditionally approved up to 1 million 'Starmind' orbital data-center satellites (deployment to start by 2033); SpaceX also said it will invest $50B+ in its Colossus 3 supercompute site in Arizona.

points.zh: SpaceX 赠股：向每个活跃 Trump Account 捐 1 股 A 类股，马斯克个人配捐（CNBC）。总股数未披露，属新增发行。
points.en: SpaceX share gift: one Class A share to every active Trump Account, matched personally by Musk (CNBC). Total shares undisclosed; these are new issuances.

points.zh: 特斯拉自身：欧盟 TCMV 会议推迟至 12 月 15 日，欧盟范围辅助驾驶批准可能拖入 2027 年；Seaport 首次覆盖给 475 美元目标价，理由是 Robotaxi。
points.en: Tesla itself: the EU TCMV meeting slips to 15 December, so EU-wide Assisted Driving approval could slide into 2027; Seaport initiated with a $475 target on Robotaxi.

tsla_analysis.zh:
美国 2026-11-25（周三）TSLA 收于 380.14 美元，较前收 384.68 美元下跌 4.54 美元（-1.18%），盘中区间 357.64–383.73 美元，成交约 3,388 万股（Yahoo Finance）；盘中一度跌约 6%，尾盘收复大半。拖累来自科技股普跌、欧盟辅助驾驶会议推迟，以及合并溢价能否兑现的质疑。同日 SPCX 收 127.44 美元（+1.30%）。合并没有公布换股比例，市场对「SpaceX 增发多少」的担忧目前更多压在 SPCX 上。卖方新动作：Seaport 首次覆盖，目标价 475 美元（Benzinga）；StockAnalysis 汇总的平均目标价 419.05 美元。美股 11 月 26 日感恩节休市，27 日提前收盘。

期权方面，OptionCharts（11 月 25 日收盘数据）显示 TSLA 30 日隐含波动率 54.65%，高于前一日的 53.26%，IV Rank 67.2、IV 百分位 98.81，30 日历史波动率 65.35%；期权成交 205 万张（30 日均值 190 万），成交认沽/认购比 0.82，未平仓比 0.78。按 7 日 IV 52.9%，未来一周预期波动约 ±7.3%（约 352–408 美元）。IV 处于一年区间偏高位置，对卖出看跌期权来说权利金较丰厚，但也反映合并、欧盟审批与年底时间窗的不确定性。以上为公开数据摘录，不是价格或波动率预测。
tsla_analysis.en:
On Wednesday 25 November 2026 TSLA closed at $380.14, down $4.54 (-1.18%) from $384.68, with a day range of $357.64–$383.73 and volume of about 33.88 million shares (Yahoo Finance); it was down about 6% intraday before recovering most of the loss. Pressure came from the broad tech sell-off, the EU's postponed Assisted Driving meeting, and doubts over whether a merger premium will survive. SPCX closed at $127.44 (+1.30%) the same day. No exchange ratio has been published, and worries about how many shares SpaceX would issue are weighing more on SPCX for now. New sell-side action: Seaport initiated with a $475 target (Benzinga); StockAnalysis puts the average target at $419.05. US markets are closed on 26 November for Thanksgiving and close early on the 27th.

In options, OptionCharts (25 November close) shows TSLA 30-day implied volatility at 54.65%, up from 53.26% the prior day, IV Rank 67.2, IV percentile 98.81 and 30-day historical volatility 65.35%; 2.05 million contracts traded (30-day average 1.90 million), with a volume put/call ratio of 0.82 and an open-interest ratio of 0.78. Seven-day IV of 52.9% implies a move of about ±7.3% over the next week (roughly $352–$408). IV sits in the upper part of its one-year range, so put premiums are rich, but that also reflects uncertainty around the merger, EU approval and the year-end window. This is a summary of public data, not a forecast of price or volatility.
